CVE-2026-83530.title: A user could provide an expression whose string length is longer  ...
CVE-2026-83530.description: A user could provide an expression whose string length is longer than the ParserExpressionSizeLimit() configured on the CEL environment, and a memory allocation would occur proportional to the size of the input before the limit would be checked / enforced.
